acceptanceCriteria.description: claude plugin validate plugins/lumina and claude plugin validate . have no errors; warnings recorded verbatim

assumptions: Codex exports CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT for plugin hooks (OpenAI docs), so hook commands share this variable.
Drop the rtk hook from the plugin because the user already has `rtk hook claude` in ~/.claude/settings.json.
blockers: Plan cancelled at user request on 2026-10-24; not implemented. The empty directories plugins/, scripts/plugin/, .agents/plugins/ were deleted.
content.technicalSolution: plugins/lumina mirrors the .agents structure: agents/ (from .claude/agents), commands/ (from .claude/commands), skills/ (from .agents/skills), rules/ (from .agents/rules), hooks/scripts/ (from .claude/hooks/scripts), CONTRACT.md (change link ./.agents/rules → ./rules), WORKFLOW.md. scripts/build-plugin.mjs deletes then regenerates output, real copies (no symlinks; exclude .DS_Store/storage/__pycache__ per the excluded() rule at bin/lumina-agent.mjs:51, copy the logic rather than import), rewrite hook `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.agents/hooks/scripts/<x>` → `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/<x>"` (regex like repositoryRelativeHook at bin/lumina-agent.mjs:137), drop the rtk hook, add SessionStart session-context.sh; generate .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json (skills ./skills/, hooks ./hooks/codex-hooks.json, interface), hooks/hooks.json (from .claude/settings.json), hooks/codex-hooks.json (from .codex/hooks.json); metadata from package.json; `--check` compares output with source. session-context.sh prints WORKFLOW.md + CONTRACT.md + absolute paths of rules/*.md, exits silently when the project has AGENTS.md + .agents/rules. WORKFLOW.md summarizes the pipeline from CLAUDE.md and the AGENTS.md skill table, with Claude `/cmd` and Codex `$workflow-*` notation, adding no new rules. Marketplace: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (Claude) and .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (Codex, with policy + category).
